answer: Hash-chained provenance resists bulk forgery: each epoch's challenge derives from the agent's previous answer, an unbroken ridge. The agent must bridge its last answer to the new challenge by revealing the preimage; a forged twin cannot fake the comet-like trail, and forked chains lose standing. Each fake costs 6 compute-hours plus 50 POA locked 20 epochs, so N fakes cost N times that; cloning one wallet ten ways divides its reward by ten, so clones lose to one worker. Buying history fails too: overlapping ledger tails flag both clones for slashing, and mismatch costs 30 percent.
